text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In front of the academy's outdoor stage,
I spotted Smart Falcon and Agnes Tachyon deep in conversation...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe☆ I'm so super happy~!
Feel free to ask me anything you want♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh...
Of course, Falco-kun.
choice_data_list: You two look like you're having fun.
You two look like you're having fun.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer!
Listen, listen!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Falco was promoting her activities here!
Telling everyone I'm working hard to become a top Umadol☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: And then Tachyon-chan said she wanted to get to know Falco better♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah... That is an undeniable fact.
However, there is no need to explain the circumstances.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
As long as I can pursue it, that's all that matters!
The potential for speed—slumbering within an Umamusume's body!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Is there a difference in the effects of the secreted endorphins?
Does the nerve impulse conduction velocity vary?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—Right this instant!
I want to study Falco-kun!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah-wah...!? Wanting to research
Falco right this second is—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Which means, Tachyon-chan!
You're officially a full-fledged Falco fan now, right?♪
choice_data_list: How does it end up like that...
How does it end up like that...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Because in order to become a top Umadol,
Falco researches her favorite idols thoroughly too! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: "Wanting to research me this much means you're totally head over heels for Falco!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Then maybe Falco should give out
the cutest fan service possible too~?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
âOho.
Going all out with fan service, are we?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In other words... I may interpret that
as you agreeing to cooperate with my research, yes?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Of cooourse! I want to live up to my fans' expectations
and boost my Umadol power eveen more♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And so, Trainer,
I'm gonna hang out with Tachyon-chan for a bit!
choice_data_list: I hope your Umadol power goes up.
I hope your Umadol power goes up.
What kind of research do you do?
What kind of research do you do?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And so, Trainer,
I'm gonna hang out with Tachyon-chan for a bit!
choice_data_list: I hope your Umadol power goes up.
I hope your Umadol power goes up.
What kind of research do you do?
What kind of research do you do?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh... Then let us begin with a checkup
in the infirmary, shall we...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I saw the two off to the infirmary
and returned to the Trainer's Office, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*pitter-patter-pitter-patter—clatter!*)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *gasp*...!
Tr-Trainaaar...!
choice_data_list: You're out of breath, what happened!?
You're out of breath, what's wrong!?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Well, you see~...
After Falco and the others arrived at the infirmary—"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well now, Falco-kun.
Have a seat in that chair right over there, if you will.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Mm☆
It's this big black chair, right—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—*clack!*)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wait... What is thisss!?
I can't move at all!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Kukuku... It's all for my research.
You'll give me plenty of fan service, won't you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In accordance with those words, I shall use your body—
to conduct biological experiments!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
—A-AN EXPERIMENT~~~!!??
No no no!! Absolutely NOTTTTT!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (――*snap snap!*)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
âOho!
Tearing through the restraints with sheer brute force, are you?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Aah-hah-hah-ha! How fascinating!
A crisis-fueled Umamusume... or rather, Umadol power, is it?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...So that happened...
and I ran away as fast as I could~...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Maybe trying to boost my Umadol power with
some fan service backfired on me... Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's hard to believe all this...
Umadol power aside, it seems her
pure strength has genuinely increased...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Falco wants to know too!
Tell me, Tachyon-chan☆

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh.
There is no need to be in such a rush.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "Because you're about to experience it yourself... until you're thoroughly sick of it."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
――Huh!?
"Taste it for yourself until you're sick of it"!?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
M-Mmh... ngh!
Tachyon-chan, what you just said...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Wait, isn't that like the culprit's line from episode 9 of "Inspiration☆Idol Detective"?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: It's a super-exciting mystery drama starring Falco's favorite idol!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
There was a scene where the idol detective protagonist
talked with the culprit—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"That was the exact same way they said it back then...!
Could it be that they're hiding something!?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
――Aahahahaha!
To think inspiration could strike in such a way!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Now that I've been exposed, there is no other choice— Right here! Right now! I shall restrain you!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
“—R-Restricted to the tracks~~~!!??
No way, no way!! Absolutely notーーー!!!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (ZWOOOOOSH!!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh... Hahahahahaha!!
I knew it, my judgment was correct!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Such reflexes! Such speed! Did quick thinking on the fly
unlock her body's full latent potential?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It seems dedicating myself solely to observation for a while
will yield far more fruitful data...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Thanks to quick wit born from daily idol research, she overcame the crisis (?)...
